annotations.title: Add an errand to my list

description: Adds one errand to the connected person's own list, in their words ('milk and eggs', 'pick up lotion at the pharmacy'), the way the app, Siri and a text to Scout do: Scout reads the store kind from the words and fits the errand into a drive they already make. Optional 'by': a day word (today, tomorrow, Friday) or a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the item as the list shows it, a confirmation line, and whether a stop on one of today's drives already fits; a stop is named only when Scout matched one, never guessed. Call this only when the person asks to add something. Needs a connected account.

by.description: A day word (today, tomorrow, Friday, next Monday) or an ISO date. Omit when they named no day.

text.description: What they need, in their words. A store named after 'at' or 'from' is kept and honoured.
